product.name: Mold Making
product.description: The process of designing and manufacturing molds used for shaping materials in production.

product.name: Injection Molding
product.description: A manufacturing process where molten material is injected into a mold to form parts or products.

product.name: Precision Cast Molding
product.description: A casting process that produces detailed and accurate molded parts using polyurethane or similar materials.

product.name: Mechanical Engineering Services
product.description: Engineering support including product development, mold design, prototyping, testing, and custom test rig creation.
